title: Breaking The Creepy AI in Police Cameras
summary: Benn Jordan explains how Flock Safety's license plate cameras log and share vehicle locations, and explores how adversarial AI can defeat them. It covers weak security and the surveillance risks of private police-camera networks.
why: HN treats it as the go-to overview of Flock's problems, and cites it in nearly every Flock thread.

quote.text: Benn Jordan did a great video on this.
